name: Inspect component details
content:
Write the knowledge record for component {{runtime.component_name}} in project {{project.id}}. The proposed set is {{task.define_components.output.components}}. Select the one object whose name equals {{runtime.component_name}}. If it is missing or duplicated, fail.

Read that component's evidence under the spokes from see:/projects for this project. Write a present-tense note: responsibility, boundary, current behavior, interfaces, and real source paths. verified_against is spoke@sha for each git spoke you actually read. Do not invent revisions.

Use MCP knowledge_component_list and knowledge_component_get for project {{project.id}}.
- No current record with this name: knowledge_component_create. Omit id.
- A current record with the same owner and consumers, but a different note or verified_against: knowledge_component_put on that id. Read conflict_token from knowledge_component_get first.
- A current record whose owner or consumers differ: knowledge_component_create. Omit id.
- An exact match: do not write.

Do not delete records. Do not touch any other component name. The final stdout line is one JSON object with applied (boolean) and id (the written id, or an empty string). Do not use a markdown fence.
